# TAP protocol documentation

> TAP is an inscribed token protocol from the Trac ecosystem, carried by Ordinal
> inscriptions on Bitcoin mainnet under the protocol tag `tap`. It keeps the
> deploy, mint and two step inscribe then send transfer of an inscribed token,
> widens the ticker space to 32 UTF-16 code units, and adds delegated authority:
> a deployment can name a privilege authority inscription in its `prv` field,
> after which privileged operations on that ticker require that authority's
> authorisation. This site documents the Bitcoin mainnet profile that Bitcoin
> Universe indexes. TAP is an upstream protocol, not a Bitcoin Universe
> invention.

Site base: https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/tap/
Owning repository: https://github.com/bitcoinuniverseio/tap
Document version: 2.0.0
Lifecycle: experimental
Chain and network: bitcoin, mainnet
Last verified: 2026-09-01

## Pages

- [Overview](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/tap/index.html): what TAP is in
  plain language, who it is for, the protocol facts pinned by the indexer and
  registry, operations at a glance, the Bitcoin Universe support matrix, related
  protocols and how to report a flaw.
- [Specification](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/tap/spec.html): numbered
  normative rules. Scope, carrier and transaction anatomy, the byte level payload
  contract for `token-transfer`, ticker rules, decimals and amounts, the operation
  table with per operation field requirements, the authority model, state
  transitions, every invalidity condition, and the indexing decisions specific to
  Bitcoin Universe.
- [Guide](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/tap/guide.html): the two step
  inscribe then send transfer worked end to end, with payloads for deploy, mint
  and transfer, the mistakes that cost money, the Bitcoin Universe support matrix
  and what the marketplace must prove before a listing exists.
- [Reference](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/tap/reference.html):
  terminology, indexer semantics, confirmation states, mempool coverage, reorg
  behaviour, marketplace policy, a concrete comparison with BRC-20, fee and size
  considerations, limitations, security considerations and an implementation
  checklist.
- [Test vectors](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/tap/vectors.html): accepted
  and rejected payloads taken from the test suite of Bitcoin Universe's TAP
  indexer, each mapped to the rule that decides it, plus a rule coverage table.
- [Validator](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/tap/validator.html): a client
  side TAP payload validator. It identifies the operation, checks required
  fields, explains the authority requirement and names the rule behind any
  rejection. Nothing pasted into it leaves the page.
- [Changelog](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/tap/changelog.html): document
  version history, versioning policy and known gaps.
- [Not found](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/tap/404.html): the error page,
  which lists every page on the site.

## Key facts

- Protocol tag: `p` equal to `tap`, exact and lower case.
- Carrier: Ordinal inscriptions. Bitcoin Universe writes TAP payloads as
  `text/plain;charset=utf-8`.
- Operations documented here: `token-deploy`, `token-mint`, `token-transfer`,
  `token-send`, `dmt-deploy`, `dmt-mint`.
- Authority bearing operations: `token-send` and `dmt-deploy`. `token-deploy` and
  `token-mint` become authority bearing when the deployment names `prv`.
- Ticker rules: NFC lower case, at most 32 UTF-16 code units and 128 UTF-8 bytes,
  no Unicode control, format or separator characters. A negative inscription
  number places the ticker in a namespace prefixed with `-`.
- Amount rules: exact JSON string matching `^(0|[1-9]\d*)(?:\.(\d+))?$`,
  fractional digits no longer than the deployment decimal scale, atomic value at
  most 78 digits, converted by string padding and never by floating point.
- Transfer content contract: required fields `p`, `op`, `tick`, `amt`, optional
  `dta` capped at 512 UTF-8 bytes. No other field, no duplicate field, no non
  string value, no byte order mark, no trailing comma, no trailing data.
- Two step transfer: inscribing a `token-transfer` moves the amount into a
  transferable balance bound to that inscription; sending the inscription credits
  the recipient and consumes it.
- Indexer coverage: `partial`. Confirmed state only, no mempool feed. Rows with a
  block height are confirmed, rows without are pending. Reorg detection is tail
  replacement only and requires positive replacement evidence.
- Marketplace: feature gated behind `tapMarketplaceV1`, in app execution,
  settlement at one Bitcoin confirmation, automatic reorg reconciliation. The
  `sell` action is unsupported, with the recorded reason "TAP has no executable
  offer workflow on this marketplace surface."
- Bitcoin Universe surfaces: Core for discovery and marketplace actions, Wallet
  for view, send and receive, Inscribe for deploy, mint and transfer. Authority
  bearing operations are not indexed or executed by any of them.

## Related

- [TAP on Doge](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/tap-on-doge/): the Dogecoin
  variant, documented in its own repository. Nothing on this site carries over.
- [docs.bitcoinuniverse.io](https://docs.bitcoinuniverse.io/): the central
  documentation portal.
- [docs.tap-protocol.com](https://docs.tap-protocol.com/): upstream TAP
  documentation from the Trac ecosystem, including operations beyond the ones
  Bitcoin Universe indexes.

## Scope and honesty

Every rule on this site is traced to code that Bitcoin Universe runs or to the
protocol registry it maintains. Where TAP defines behaviour that does not appear
in that code, this site says so and points upstream rather than restating rules
it cannot verify. Support claims cover Bitcoin Universe surfaces only, and record
what the product code implements rather than what is enabled in production.
